title: [devx] Live E2E UI follow-ups: pin its timeout ceiling from the first CI population, and retire the stale backend-pin header in saved-view-filter.spec.ts
body:
Filing gate: follow-up owed by landed work (filing-gate.md, "已落地工作欠的后续照立卡"). This covers two items #27212 (#27154) left out of scope on purpose: should-fix 3 of contract review record 6467449484 (OQ2 A), and that record's out-of-scope finding. Raised by devx seat 2 (`session_01QSeKYmTYfaPbLQD4BJfomW`).

Restart-when: test "$(date -u +%F)" \> 2026-11-03  # one week of `main` push and scheduled CI runs after #27212 (merged 2026-10-28); on wake, count completed `Live E2E UI` runs on `main` and dispatch only at ≥ 20

**Business reason.** The new required `Live E2E UI` job has a `timeout-minutes: 40` ceiling. It was derived from a single cold local run, and no test pins it. Its siblings' ceilings are pinned in `turbo-cache-save-bound.test.ts`, and the F13 comment above `lint-ui` says that file "holds both values". An unpinned ceiling can drift silently. If it is too tight, a required context goes red on slow runners. If it is too loose, a hung backend holds the merge queue for 40 minutes.

Separately, the header of `ui/e2e/live/saved-view-filter.spec.ts` still says the lane measures against "the published backend this lane pins — `OBJECTSTACK_VERSION` in `e2e/live/ci/backend.env`". #27212 retires that pin: the lane now boots the workspace's own `@objectstack/cli` on `examples/app-showcase`. #27154's claim forbade spec edits, so the header was left as it is. The next reader of that spec will be told the wrong backend.

**Steps.**
1. Once `main` carries #27212 and has at least 20 completed `Live E2E UI` runs (push and scheduled), read their durations from the Actions API. Re-derive the ceiling with the sibling jobs' method (the derivation in the job comment). Set it in `ci.yml` and pin it in `turbo-cache-save-bound.test.ts`. This edits `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, so it is Tier H and needs a ruling citation; #25914's ruling 6464191239 (letter D) authorized the job.
2. In the same PR, rewrite the `saved-view-filter.spec.ts` header to name the workspace backend (`ui/e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`, `LIVE_BACKEND_APP`), not the retired pin. Comment only; no assertion moves.

**Reader who acts.** devx seat, one PR, once the population exists. #27212 merged on 2026-10-28; the card waits on the 20-run population.

**Dedupe.** `search_issues` (semantic) for "Live E2E UI timeout-minutes ceiling pin turbo-cache-save-bound saved-view-filter spec header": 0 hits. **New.**
